title: Executive Compensation Limits and Executive Turnover
authors: Vikram K. Nanda; Sabatino Dino Silveri; Kun Wang; Le Zhao
eligible_reason: Single common policy date: the pay-limit policy for central SOEs applies from 2010 for all affected firms (Master_Final_MS.do line 15 gen dyear = year>2009; treatment dyear_csoes = csoes x dyear). Every column adds time-varying firm controls ($cv, $cv1, $cv2, $cv3). Not staggered.
design_notes: Stata xtreg fe with i.year, firm-year CSMAR panel 2003-2014, clustered by firm; event-time version with bf2 bf1 af09..af14; matched-sample and subsample splits.
data_files_note: Readme.pdf: licensed CSMAR data; package ships only the do file, log, Readme and variable list.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Common-date policy DiD; licensed data not shipped.
